theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgiDens_ball_volume_ge
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ), ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ (U G : Set (Rn (n + 1))) (μ : Measure (Rn (n + 1))) (ν : Rn (n + 1) → Rn (n + 1)), IsOpen U → NullMeasurableSet G volume → IsGaussGreenPair U G μ ν → ∀ (x w : Rn (n + 1)) (ρ₁ : ℝ), ‖w‖ ≤ 1 → Metric.ball x ρ₁ ⊆ U → (∀ ρ ∈ Ioo 0 ρ₁, 0 < μ (Metric.ball x ρ) ∧ (μ (Metric.ball x ρ)).toReal ≤ 2 * ∫ y in Metric.ball x ρ, inner ℝ (ν y) w ∂μ) → ∀ ρ ∈ Ioo 0 ρ₁, ENNReal.ofReal (c * ρ ^ (n + 1)) ≤ volume (G ∩ Metric.ball x ρ)
